source.name: vw_RecentOrders
source.sourceDefinition:
-- =============================================================================
-- SCHEMA: Risk Level 2 - Simple translations (TOP, ISNULL, GETDATE, etc.)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_RecentOrders AS
    SELECT TOP 100
        o.OrderID,
        c.FirstName + ' ' + c.LastName AS CustomerName,
        o.OrderDate,
        ISNULL(o.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
    FROM dbo.Orders o
    INNER JOIN dbo.Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.vw_recentorders AS
SELECT 
 o.OrderID,
 c.FirstName + ' ' + c.LastName AS CustomerName,
 o.OrderDate,
 ISNULL(o.TotalAmount, 0) AS TotalAmount
